title: Generative-polynomial reduction and fixed-multiplier suspension class lattices

retained_primary_inputs.title: Closed and Irreducible Polynomials in Several Variables
retained_primary_inputs.portions_inspected: Section 2 arbitrary-field setup, Definitions 1-2, Theorem 1(i) to (iii), its proof through Proposition 1, and Lemma 3. Theorem 1(iv)-(v) and Proposition 2 were inspected but are not used in this proof.
retained_primary_inputs.exact_import: Theorem 1(i) to (iii), noncomposite implies closed, over the non-algebraically-closed characteristic-zero field C(T).
retained_primary_inputs.role: The earlier retained HC4MYHX0 application used C. This note explicitly audits the same implication over C(T); it does not silently attribute the expanded field scope to that earlier C-only application. Minimal inner degree supplies generative-polynomial existence. The denominator argument reproduces relative field closedness, and finite Galois disjointness proves the exact geometric generic-fibre assertion directly.

direct_proof_arguments: minimal inner joint degree gives a noncomposite polynomial over C(T)
the denominator field argument and finite Galois disjointness prove geometric generic integrality without special-fibre classification
the outer one-variable root action is exactly the action on geometric multivariable factors
fixed-multiplier localization gives one copy of the outer root lattice per distinct irreducible multiplier factor
unit relations determine the exact lattice independently of multiplier multiplicities
transitivity makes each source-fixed root-lattice subgroup zero
the original polynomial relation gives a global free filtration and every affine height-one fibre is geometrically integral
zero source-fixed classes trigger the retained global component-pencil proof and carried inverse
ambient and target polynomial automorphisms preserve the carried-output obstruction
